nodes.description: Biallelic germline MYO5A variants remove functional myosin Va, the actin-based motor of the RAB27A-melanophilin-myosin Va melanosome complex. The variants reported in neurological GS1 are truncating (nonsense and frameshift), so every isoform of the protein is lost. That is the point at which the disease branches: the same null allele removes the exon-F-containing isoform melanocytes use and the isoform neurons use, which is why GS1, unlike GS3, carries a neurological disease.
